options.content: **Data since ${go_live}.** There is no backfill: charts start empty at go-live and fill as the collector runs. All times are UTC.

**UNVERIFIED.** These panels are built to the columns visible in the Metabase screenshots; the v1 SQL was not recovered. Definitions are the analytics agent's best reading and must be confirmed against the owner's Metabase export. Because there is no backfill, 60-day lapse measures are not meaningful until about 60 days after go-live.

panels.title: Active controllers
panels.description: UNVERIFIED (screenshot only; showed 178). Assumed: controllers whose latest session started in the last 90 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Active controllers" FROM controller_activity_summary WHERE last_session >= now() - interval '90 days'

panels.title: Lapsed 30 days
panels.description: UNVERIFIED (screenshot only; showed 28). Assumed: controllers active in the last 90 days whose latest session started more than 30 days ago.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Lapsed" FROM controller_activity_summary
WHERE last_session >= now() - interval '90 days' AND last_session < now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Controller retention rate
panels.description: UNVERIFIED (screenshot only; showed 84%, bands red below 65, amber 65 to 85, green above 85). The screenshot figures (178 active, 28 lapsed, 84%) are consistent with retention = (active - lapsed) / active.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * (count(*) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_session < now() - interval '30 days'))
              / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 0) AS "Retention (%)"
FROM controller_activity_summary
WHERE last_session >= now() - interval '90 days'

panels.title: Reactivated in the last 30 days after 60+ days lapsed
panels.description: UNVERIFIED (screenshot only; showed 74). Assumed: controllers with a session in the last 30 days whose previous session ended more than 60 days before it started.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Reactivated" FROM controller_activity_summary
WHERE recent_sessions > 0 AND gap_days_before_recent > 60

panels.title: Who might need help reactivating?
panels.description: UNVERIFIED (screenshot only). Assumed: controllers who started sessions in the last 30 days but were online for under 1 hour in total with no session longer than 30 minutes, newest first. Columns follow the screenshot.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cid, name, rank_group,
       first_recent_session::date AS first_session,
       last_recent_session::date AS last_session,
       recent_sessions, hours_last_30d AS hours_last_30d, longest_session_minutes
FROM controller_activity_summary
WHERE recent_sessions > 0
  AND hours_last_30d < 1
  AND longest_session_minutes < 30
ORDER BY last_recent_session DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Who reactivated after being away for more than 60 days?
panels.description: UNVERIFIED (screenshot only). Controllers with a session in the last 30 days whose previous session ended more than 60 days earlier. Columns follow the screenshot.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cid, name, rank_group,
       first_recent_session::date AS first_session,
       last_recent_session::date AS last_session,
       recent_sessions, hours_last_30d, gap_days_before_recent AS days_away
FROM controller_activity_summary
WHERE recent_sessions > 0 AND gap_days_before_recent > 60
ORDER BY first_recent_session DESC
LIMIT 50
